speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The clinical presentation of a continuous heart murmur (patent ductus arteriosus), bluish non-blanching skin macules (rash), and cloudy lenses (chorioretinitis) in an immunologically naive newborn is classic for congenital syphilis, not cellulitis.
